error: error: No interpreter found for Python 3.7 in managed installations or search path
why: The README requires Python 3.7.0 (not installable on Ubuntu 24.04, uv has no 3.7) and its requirements.txt contradicts it: torch>=2.6.0 needs Python 3.9+ while numpy==1.15.4 and scipy==1.1.0 need 3.7 or older, so no single Python satisfies the README.
